Welcome to the course website. Use this page to orient students: state what
they will learn, how the material is organized, and where to begin.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Start here

Open [the first lesson](lessons/first-lesson.qmd) to see prose, a figure,
executable Python, an exercise, and a profile-dependent solution.
:::

## Learning goals

After working through the example module, learners should be able to:

- identify the main concept introduced by the lesson;
- use a small computational model to explore it; and
- explain their result in plain language.

## How to use these notes

Read the explanation, run or adapt the examples, and complete each exercise
before comparing your work with any feedback provided by the instructor.
